links.outcome: Forecast accuracy of zero-shot foundation models versus optimized task-specific models on the same data
links.effect: Task-specific models outperformed zero-shot foundation models in accuracy across three clinical use cases; zero-shot models generalized strongly to external datasets.
links.quote: Across three clinical use cases, task-specific models outperformed zero-shot models in accuracy, but zero-shot models demonstrated strong generalization in external datasets.

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks zero-shot time series foundation models against task-specific models using EHR data across external validation datasets to assess generalizability.
